summary.text: John Carson, a Republican, has represented District 30 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2025, when Douglas County Republicans appointed him to replace Kevin Van Winkle.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Carson served on the University of Colorado Board of Regents (District 6) from 2015 to 2021 and served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve from 1979 to 1985.
He earned a B.A. in political science (1983) and a J.D. (1987) from the University of Colorado Boulder and an LL.M. in taxes from Georgetown University Law Center (1996).
He was Rocky Mountain Regional Director of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development from 2001 to 2009 and later joined the law firm Snell & Wilmer.
